test_recursive_parse_cohere_schema: test the recursive_parse function with a cohere-style schema to parse assistant responses containing thinking and tool calls
test_recursive_parse_ernie_schema: test the recursive_parse function with an ernie-style schema to parse assistant responses containing thinking, content, and tool calls
test_recursive_parse_gpt_oss_schema: test the recursive_parse function with a gpt-oss-style schema to parse assistant responses containing analysis and commentary sections
test_recursive_parse_qwen3_schema: test the recursive_parse function with a qwen3-style schema to parse assistant responses containing function calls with parameter blocks
test_recursive_parse_re_sub_schema: test the recursive_parse function with a re_sub schema that uses regex substitutions to enable JSON parsing of tool call arguments
test_recursive_parse_gemma4_tool_call: test the recursive_parse function with a gemma4 schema to parse tool calls using the gemma4-tool-call parser
test_tokenizer_parse_response_method: test the tokenizer.parse_response method as a convenience wrapper around recursive_parse for parsing model outputs
test_tokenizer_schema_save_load: test saving and loading a tokenizer with a response_schema to persist chat parsing configuration across reloads
test_required_fields_validation: test that recursive_parse raises ValueError when required schema fields are missing from the parsed output
